questions.q: Shortness of breath with dry, barking, croupy cough like a saw through a pine board, worse before midnight, calls for:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Spongia: sawing cough.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, sensations like 'as if a band around the head' are found under:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. Particular sensations are under the relevant body part.

questions.q: Chlorination of drinking water aims to leave a free residual chlorine of about:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Ensures continued disinfection.

questions.q: In §3 Hahnemann lists among the physician's duties knowing the obstacles to recovery and how to remove them. Such obstacles are:
opts: causes that maintain the disease, such as faulty diet or living conditions
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. Maintaining causes block cure.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, palpitation of the heart is looked up in the chapter:
questions.why: Kent has no Heart chapter; palpitation and heart symptoms sit in Chest.

questions.q: Which of the following is a specific treponemal test for syphilis?
questions.why: TPHA detects antibodies against Treponema pallidum antigens; VDRL, RPR and Kahn are non-treponemal tests using cardiolipin.

questions.q: The average duration of a normal pregnancy from the first day of the last menstrual period is:
questions.why: Topic 8, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Paediatrics. 40 weeks.

questions.q: White blood cell casts in urine are characteristic of:
questions.why: WBC casts form in the tubules and so localise inflammation to the kidney, as in pyelonephritis; cystitis gives pus cells without casts.

questions.q: The abbreviation 'p.c.' on a prescription means:
questions.why: P.c. is post cibum, after food.

questions.q: Under the MTP (Amendment) Act 2021, the opinion of two registered doctors is needed for termination at (GPSC Medical Officer, 2025):
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. One doctor up to 20 weeks; a medical board beyond 24 weeks for fetal anomalies.
